    for cmd,(dx,dy) in dungeon.MOVES.items():
        nx,ny=g.px+dx,g.py+dy
        if 0<=nx<dungeon.W and 0<=ny<dungeon.H and g.grid[ny][nx]!=dungeon.WALL:
            g.move(cmd); steps+=1; break
    else:
        break

\""

item.text: Let me verify the dungeon is actually solvable (BFS from start to stairs).

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'cd /workspace && python3 -c "
from collections import deque
import dungeon
g = dungeon.Game()
start=(g.px,g.py); goal=(1,1)
q=deque([start]); seen={start}
while q:
    x,y=q.popleft()
    if (x,y)==goal: break
    for dx,dy in dungeon.MOVES.values():
        nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
        if 0<=nx<dungeon.W and 0<=ny<dungeon.H and g.grid[ny][nx]!=dungeon.WALL and (nx,ny) not in seen:
            seen.add((nx,ny)); q.append((nx,ny))
print('"'reachable from start:', (x,y)==goal)
\""
